name: Annual Leave
description: Yearly vacation leave for rest and recreation

name: Sick Leave
description: Medical leave for illness or health-related issues. Ensures employees can recover properly without affecting productivity.

name: Emergency Leave
description: Urgent leave for unexpected personal or family emergencies

name: Compensatory Leave
description: Time off provided in exchange for overtime or extra working hours. Helps maintain work-life balance after extended or weekend duties.

name: Personal Leave
description: Personal time off for individual matters and commitments

name: Marriage Leave
description:
Special leave granted for wedding ceremonies and related functions.
Allows employees to manage personal commitments during important life events.
